Internal helper: the names kept for built-in styles still to come

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_style_reserved.Rd

A built-in's name wins over any file, so a file saved under the name of a built-in a later version adds would stop being read the day that version is installed, and a file based on it would change its base. jstyle(save.as = ) refuses these names, as it refuses a built-in's (Session 407). A name moves from here to .jst_style_builtin() when its style ships: report did at Session 409, and none is kept now.

Usage

.jst_style_reserved
